name: magical girl suicide pact
source:
Yui has always loved magical girls, but she loves The Chariot most of all. After years of searching, she’s finally found her… with just one small problem: she’s about to take her own life. The two agree to meet up under the premise of forming a suicide pact, but Yui has no intention of honoring it. Can she successfully save her idol from death?
